title: Sr. Talent Acquisition Executive
description:
**Job Information**
-------------------

* Department Name People & Culture
* Work Experience 3 - 6 Years
* Date Opened 13/11/2026
* Job Type Full time
* Industry IT Services
* Required Skills
  + mobile applications
  + IT recruitment
  + +5
* City Kochi
* Province Kerala
* Country India
* Postal Code 682303

**Job Description**
-------------------

2Base Technologies is a custom software development company with over 16 years of delivery experience. We work as an enterprise solutions partner for clients in the United Kingdom, the United States, India, and other markets, building web and mobile applications and end-to-end digital solutions across industries.

  

We are looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Executive to join our People & Culture team and take ownership of our end-to-end hiring function.

This role is for someone who enjoys finding the right people, building talent pipelines, influencing candidates, and closing positions, not simply forwarding CVs.

  

**What You’ll Own**

* Own the complete recruitment lifecycle from understanding the requirement to candidate joining and onboarding follow-up.
* Work closely with hiring managers to understand the role, define the right candidate profile, and establish hiring timelines.
* Source candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, Foundit, Indeed, referrals, networking, and direct outreach.
* Take ownership of active and passive candidate sourcing, especially for difficult-to-fill technology and senior positions.
* Conduct initial screening and evaluate candidates based on skills, experience, motivation, compensation, availability, and cultural fit.
* Manage multiple open positions simultaneously while maintaining clear priorities and timelines.
* Coordinate interviews and ensure a smooth candidate experience throughout the hiring process.
* Own offer discussions, negotiation, and candidate closure while working within approved compensation bands.
* Maintain accurate and timely recruitment data in Zoho Recruit, including candidate stages, feedback, interview status, and closure details.
* Build and maintain strong talent pools for recurring and future hiring requirements.
* Track recruitment performance through metrics such as time-to-hire, source effectiveness, stage conversion, offer acceptance, and joining ratio.
* Provide regular hiring updates and insights to hiring managers and the People & Culture leadership.
* Stay updated on talent-market trends, salary benchmarks, competitor hiring, and availability of key technology skills.
Explore and implement new sourcing methods, recruitment technology, and AI-assisted hiring tools that improve speed and quality.  

  
  

### **Requirements**

**What We’re Looking For**

* 3–6 years of hands-on experience in IT recruitment, preferably in a software services or product company.
* Proven experience hiring for technical and non-technical positions, particularly engineering and technology roles.
* Strong hands-on sourcing skills across LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, Foundit, Indeed, Boolean search, X-ray search, referrals, and direct sourcing.
* Ability to understand technical job requirements and assess whether a candidate’s experience genuinely matches the role.
* Strong candidate engagement and negotiation skills, particularly during offer and closure stages.
* Experience managing multiple positions and competing hiring priorities independently.
* Hands-on experience with an ATS or Recruitment Management System; experience with Zoho Recruit is an advantage.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills with the confidence to interact with candidates at all levels.
* Strong ownership, follow-through, and accountability. You should be comfortable taking responsibility for a role from requirement to joining.
* Data-driven approach to recruitment, with the ability to identify what is working and what needs to change.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change, and hiring requirements can be urgent.
* Based in Kochi or willing to relocate to Kochi.
* Willing to work on-site at our Infopark office, five days a week.
* Experience building long-term talent pools or candidate communities.
* Experience hiring for Tech and non-Technical positions.
* Experience conducting walk-in drives, campus hiring, or large-scale recruitment campaigns.
* Experience creating or improving recruitment processes, SOPs, or hiring playbooks.
Hands-on experience using AI tools to improve sourcing, screening, or recruitment productivity.  

  

**Why This Role at 2Base?**

* Real ownership: You will own hiring, not just one part of the recruitment process.
* Direct exposure: Work closely with the People & Culture leadership, hiring managers, and business leadership.
* Variety of hiring: From freshers to senior technology professionals across Engineering, Product, Marketing, Design and Operations.
* Build the function: You will have the opportunity to improve our sourcing strategy, processes, candidate pipelines and recruitment technology.
* Use AI meaningfully: Explore practical ways to use AI and automation to make recruitment faster and more effective.
Grow beyond recruitment: You will work closely with the wider People & Culture function and gain exposure to people operations, performance, capability building and employee engagement.  

  

**If You Are Someone Who**

finds people others can’t, builds relationships that last, takes ownership of every position, and enjoys turning a difficult requirement into a successful hire, we’d like to meet you.

  

### **Benefits**

A growth-driven environment with opportunities to lead, innovate, and upskill continuously.

title: Assistant Manager - Talent Acquisition
description:
Malabar Group is seeking a dynamic and results-driven **Assistant Manager Talent Acquisition** to lead and execute end-to-end recruitment activities for retail operations. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in **core talent acquisition**, particularly within the **retail industry**, and possess excellent stakeholder management and sourcing capabilities.

**Role & responsibilities** :

* Manage the **end-to-end recruitment lifecycle** (sourcing to onboarding) for critical and mid-level retail roles.
* Drive hiring for **retail positions** such as Sales Executives, Store Managers, Cluster Managers, and support roles.
* Implement innovative sourcing strategies using **job portals, social media, referrals, walk-ins, and campus hiring**.
* Build and maintain a strong **talent pipeline** for ongoing and future requirements.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand role requirements and deliver timely closures.
* Ensure a seamless and **positive candidate experience** throughout the recruitment journey.
* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of **Talent Acquisition Executives/Recruiters**.
* Allocate hiring requisitions and monitor individual/team performance against **KPIs and hiring targets**.
* Track recruitment metrics and generate reports on **time-to-hire, cost-per-hire, and hiring effectiveness**.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and recruitment best practices.
* Support employer branding initiatives and participate in hiring events, job fairs, and retail hiring campaigns.

**Requirements:**

* **6 to 8 years** of experience in **core Talent Acquisition / Recruitment**.
* Masters Degree (MBA/PGDM in HR or related field) is preferred .
* Mandatory experience in **retail hiring** (preferably in large retail chains, FMCG retail, jewelry, or lifestyle sectors).
* Proven experience in **team handling along with direct hiring responsibility**.
* Strong understanding of **retail recruitment lifecycle and bulk hiring**.
* Proven ability to manage **high-volume hiring** within tight deadlines.
* Excellent **communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills**.
* Familiarity with **ATS tools and job portals** (Naukri, LinkedIn, etc.).
* Strong stakeholder management and coordination skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.

Pay: ₹40,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Kochi, Kerala: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Education:

* Master's (Required)

Experience:

* Retail hiring : 4 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: HR Recruiter
description:
HR Recruiter

Catalyst Education – Kochi, Kerala

Job Type: Full-time

Salary: ₹10,000 – ₹15,000 per month (Based on experience)

Schedule: Day Shift

About Us

Catalyst Education is a fast-growing educational organization based in Kochi, Kerala. We specialize in student counseling, career pathways, and academic program management. To support our expanding teams, we are looking for a dynamic and organized HR Recruiter to manage our end-to-end recruitment process.

Job Overview

HR Recruiter to join our internal human resources team in Kochi. In this role, you will be responsible for sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding candidates for various roles (such as Academic Counselors, Telecallers, and Sales Executives).

If you have a keen eye for talent, strong interpersonal skills, and want to build a career in Human Resources, we would love to connect with you.

Key Responsibilities

\* Sourcing & Sifting: Source active and passive candidates using job portals (Indeed, LinkedIn), social media, and professional networks.

\* Screening & Shortlisting: Review resumes and conduct initial telephonic/virtual screenings to assess candidate suitability, communication skills, and cultural fit.

\* Interview Coordination: Schedule and coordinate interviews with department heads and senior management.

\* Candidate Management: Maintain regular communication with candidates throughout the hiring pipeline to ensure a smooth candidate experience.

\* Onboarding & Documentation: Assist with onboarding formalities, documentation, and maintenance of employee records.

\* Pipeline Management: Maintain accurate tracking reports and recruitment metrics.

Requirements & Qualifications

\* Education: Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business Administration, Psychology, or any related stream (MBA in HR is a plus).

\* Experience: Freshers with exceptional communication skills or candidates with 0–2 years of experience in HR recruitment, talent acquisition, or HR coordination.

\* Language Proficiency: Fluency in English and Malayalam is required.

\* Skills: Excellent communication, strong organizational skills, and proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel) and email correspondence.

Benefits & Perks

\* Fixed monthly salary between ₹10,000 – ₹15,000.

\* Supportive, growth-oriented work environment.

\* Professional development and hands-on experience in corporate HR management.

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹15,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
